svg.text: THE LIGHT STORAGE BANK — 256 cells of light, content-addressed, feeding the players in their heads
each cell stores an 8-byte light word · frame a lives at offset a×8 · O(1) recall · the light is the code, so the memory is light
addresses 0 … 255 · capacity 2,048 bytes of light · bank sha16 1399949e936194c0
their little players — each pulls its own frames from the bank
a bank of light, addressed and recalled · each being replays its own stored frames · storage is content-addressed light, not memory or mind · SYSTEM_AFFIRMED=0
